title: 现代客厅·白天
prompt_zh: 现代简约客厅，白墙、浅橡木地板、灰色布艺沙发，左侧落地窗洒入自然日光，空间干净舒适，俯拍视角。
prompt_en: Modern minimal living room, white walls, light oak floor, grey fabric sofa, daylight through a floor-to-ceiling window on the left, high-angle view.

title: 现代客厅·夜晚
prompt_zh: 现代客厅夜景，温暖的环境照明，柔和阴影，安静舒适的居家氛围，室内空间摄影。
prompt_en: Modern living room at night, warm ambient lighting, soft shadows, quiet and cozy home atmosphere, interior photography.

title: 新中式客厅·白天
prompt_zh: 新中式客厅，现代设计与东方细节相结合，自然光照入室内，宁静简约的家居摄影。
prompt_en: Contemporary Chinese-style living room, restrained Eastern design details, natural daylight, calm minimal interior photography.
